technical_quality: Adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac shadow); minimal rotation (clavicular heads roughly symmetric about the spinous processes; trachea midline); inspiration somewhat shallow with low lung volumes and crowding of basal vessels; large body habitus with bilateral breast shadows overlying the lower zones; whole thorax and upper abdomen included; L marker present at image upper right confirming conventional orientation.

devices.location: Soft tissue over the right shoulder, image upper-left corner
Top edge of image, right of midline (over patient's left shoulder/neck region)
Image upper right corner over the patient's left shoulder; confirms patient's left is on image right

devices.type: Round metallic ring artifact (marker holder / clip, external)
devices.location: Immediately above the L marker, patient's left shoulder soft tissue

abnormalities.finding: Hazy patchy air-space/interstitial opacity medially, adjacent to the right heart border, with partial indistinctness of the right cardiac border; suspicious for right middle/lower lobe infiltrate (pneumonia). Approx. 5-6 cm.
Increased interstitial / bronchovascular markings with peribronchial thickening, more pronounced in both lower zones; partly accentuated by low lung volumes and overlying breast shadows.
Mild hazy retrocardiac / left basal density without air bronchograms; less conspicuous than the right side, indeterminate (crowding vs early infiltrate).
Low lung volumes / shallow inspiration with crowding of basal vasculature.
Heart size at the upper limit of normal (CTR approx 0.5), may be exaggerated by shallow inspiration; mediastinum central, no widening; hila not enlarged (left hilum slightly prominent).

Multiple rounded, well-defined radiopaque densities in the lower abdomen on both sides (clusters right of midline and in the left lower quadrant); likely ingested tablets or calcifications (phleboliths / calcified nodes) - incidental extra-thoracic finding.

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（疑為PA view），吸氣量稍不足、肺容積偏低，患者無明顯旋轉，穿透度尚可；雙側肩部可見衣物金屬扣及左上方之L側標記與圓形金屬體外異物，體內未見任何管路、引流管或起搏器。雙肺紋理增加並伴支氣管周圍增厚，以雙下肺野較明顯，右下肺野內側近右心緣處可見片狀模糊浸潤影（約5–6公分），右心緣局部略不清晰，疑為右中／下葉肺炎；左下肺野心後區亦有輕微霧狀密度增加，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利。心臟大小約在正常上限（CTR約0.5），縱膈居中、氣管位置正常，左肺門略顯突出；骨骼結構無明顯異常，左橫膈下可見正常胃泡，下腹部另見多顆圓形高密度影，疑為口服藥丸或鈣化點，屬偶然發現。
